title: 2025 Reunion - CEO Conversation: Tom Gayner & Jennifer Mann, Coca Cola
description:
On this year's CEO Conversation panel at the 2025 Reunion, Tom Gayner was joined by Jennifer Mann, President of the North America operating segment at Coca Cola. The panel was moderated by the inimitable Richard Coughlan, Professor at the University of Richmond Robins School of Business.

Tom, Jennifer, and Richard explored Jennifer's journey through Coca Cola to run their largest operating segment, the lessons she has learned along the way, and her reflections on being an operator.

Learn more about the Reunion at mklreunion.com
